about: The 40 sentences one person reads aloud, in this order. The text is the ground truth. 'target': a listed word said in a context that fits it (each of the 10 targets twice). 'protected': a word that is NOT on the list but sounds like a listed name, said in its own ordinary meaning (each of the 5 twice); changing it into the listed name is a wrong correction. 'control': no listed word at all.
